# Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03

Vendored, unmodified, from https://github.com/aloistr/swisseph (tag `v2.10.03`).
Copyright (C) 1997–2021 Astrodienst AG, Switzerland. Used under the GNU AGPL —

Only the library sources are kept (no test programs). The data files

based on JPL DE441) come from the same repository's `ephe/` directory.
